title: Head of Internal Audit
description: About Faire Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive. We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours. About this role We're looking for a Head of Internal Audit to build Faire's Internal Audit function and lead our SOX (financial controls) program as we prepare for public company requirements. You’ll partner with process owners across the company to make sure our key controls are well designed, operating effectively, and supported by complete and accurate data. This role owns the audit plan, is an independent voice on risk and controls, and partners closely with the Audit Committee. You'll inherit a small SOX team and shape how it's structured as Internal Audit grows, with scope that may expand into areas like enterprise risk management. You'll also help govern how Faire builds and uses AI, and use data and AI to make audit faster and more continuous. As Finance and the business rebuild workflows around AI, you’ll make sure those workflows are SOX compliant by design: advising on controls throughout the build process, setting the standard for evidence and review, and giving the Audit Committee and our external auditor confidence in the results. You understand our technology environment, have built or scaled an audit function at a fast-growing tech company, and are ready to roll up your sleeves. You see the Internal Audit function as a partner to the business, not a checkpoint. This role reports to the CAO, with a functional reporting line to the CFO and the Audit Committee of the Board. What you’ll do  Build and lead Faire's Internal Audit function, including the audit plan, team, and outside partners Lead our SOX team and own the SOX program, including readiness for our first external audit of internal controls Review controls over our technology: cloud, software changes, system access, data, and cybersecurity Provide independent assurance over how Faire builds and uses AI, including model errors, bias, and privacy Modernize audit with data analytics, automation, and responsible AI to test more and monitor continuously Give the Audit Committee and executives a clear, candid view of risk and control health Partner with Finance, Legal, Security, Privacy, and Engineering to advise on controls early for new products, systems, and expansion Track issues to closure and push for root-cause fixes Hire, coach, and develop the team and manage outside audit partners Take on special projects, analysis, and reporting as needed Qualifications Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, information systems, or a related field, plus at least one of CPA, CIA, CISA, or CISSP 12+ years in audit and risk, including 6+ reviewing IT and financial controls and 3+ leading teams Deep SOX experience, including IPO readiness or first-year external auditor review of internal controls Strong understanding of the technology environment, including IT controls, cloud, data, and cybersecurity Working knowledge of AI risk and governance, including generative and agentic AI, and experience using AI or analytics in audit Knowledge of US GAAP, COSO, PCAOB, and IIA standards Experience presenting to Audit Committees, boards, and senior executives Experience selecting audit and risk technology Experience building an internal audit function at a tech company; hyper-growth or marketplace experience is a plus Strong communicator with sound judgment in ambiguous situations Resourceful and not afraid to roll up your sleeves Salary range: San Francisco: The salary range for this role is $200,000 - $275,000 per year. This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.   Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.  Why you’ll love working at

title: Lead Solution & Enterprise Architect
description: Lead Solution & Enterprise Architect Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent Shape complex technology solutions and help redefine the future of financial services. The Role Lead the design of complex, resilient technology solutions that help financial services organisations modernise their platforms, address architectural challenges and deliver meaningful business outcomes. At Capco, you will play a pivotal role in delivering some of our clients’ most complex and high-profile transformation programmes, drawing on your expertise in solution architecture and technology transformation. You will move between hands-on solution design, collaborating closely with engineers, and articulating compelling technology visions to senior stakeholders. You will bring sound technical judgement, constructive challenge and a clear understanding of client objectives to architectural decisions, ensuring that solutions are secure, maintainable and aligned with business priorities. You will work across business, data, application and technology domains, guide cross-functional teams and support the development of colleagues. You will also have opportunities to contribute to enterprise architecture strategy and technology roadmaps, alongside supporting the growth of our Technology & Engineering Practice through community leadership, delivery excellence and business development. What You'll Do Lead the design and delivery of complex, scalable, secure and resilient solutions across legacy and cloud environments, applying modern distributed architecture patterns and engineering principles. Translate business objectives into practical technology solutions, evaluating architectural options, managing technical trade-offs and ensuring designs deliver measurable value, reliability and long-term maintainability. Lead cross-functional architecture and engineering teams, promoting collaboration, delivery excellence, continuous learning and the development of colleagues. Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, communicate compelling architecture visions and influence strategic decisions while contributing to business development and commercial opportunities. Explore and apply approved AI tools, automation and AI-enabled workflows to strengthen architecture analysis, design documentation and delivery efficiency, ensuring appropriate human review, security controls, responsible AI governance and clear escalation pathways. What We're Looking For Proven experience leading complex solution architecture initiatives, translating business and technology requirements into practical, high-quality solutions. Strong architectural judgement, with the ability to evaluate options, challenge assumptions constructively and balance delivery priorities with security, reliability and maintainability. Ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, communicate complex technical concepts clearly and influence decisions across business and technology teams. Experience guiding multidisciplinary technical teams, encouraging engineering excellence, collaboration, knowledge sharing and effective problem-solving. Commercial awareness and a client-focused mindset, with the ability to understand business objectives, identify opportunities for improvement and deliver meaningful outcomes. Technical Skills & Experience Essential requirements Strong solution architecture experience across legacy and cloud environments, including practical experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure. Experience applying modern distributed architecture patterns, including microservices, event-driven, containerised, serverless and zero-trust architectures. Working knowledge of recognised architecture frameworks and methods, including TOGAF, Zachman, Domain-driven Design or NIST. Experience working within Agile and DevOps delivery environments, collaborating closely with engineering teams to support effective solution implementation. Bonus Points For Experience shaping enterprise architecture strategies, technology roadmaps and governance frameworks across complex organisations. Experience designing greenfield architectures, cloud-first enterprises or establishing and maturing enterprise architecture functions within agile delivery environments. Senior-level consulting experience, ideally within financial services or other regulated industries with complex compliance, risk and security requirements. Experience leading pre-sales activities, proposals or bids, including commercial ownership and client engagement. Awareness of emerging AI capabilities, including Generative AI and Agentic AI, and their potential application to enterprise architecture and engineering productivity; relevant professional certifications in architecture frameworks or cloud technologies are also welcomed. Why Join Capco Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions. Work in a collaborative, flat and entrepreneurial consulting culture. Access continuous learning, training and industry certifications. Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services. Help shape the future of digital transformation across financial services and energy. Benefits We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life: Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover. Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders. Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause, and bereavement. Family Care: 8 complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care. Holiday Flexibility: 5 weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday days based on your needs. Continuous Learning: Your growth, your way – a minimum of 40 hours of training annually. Take your pick from workshops, certifications and e-learning. You'll also be assigned a Business Coach from Day One, offering one-on-one guidance to support your goals and accelerate your development. Healthcare Access: Convenient online GP services. Extra Perks: Gympass (Wellhub), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, Cycle to Work, and dental insurance. Inclusion at Capco We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day. #LI-DNI Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Vice President, Servicing & Collections
description: About Pagaya Shape the Future of Finance Pagaya is building a leading artificial intelligence network to help our partners grow their businesses and better serve their customers. Pagaya is a global technology company making life-changing financial products and services available to more people nationwide, as it reshapes the financial services ecosystem. By using machine learning, a vast data network and a sophisticated AI-driven approach, Pagaya provides comprehensive consumer credit and residential real estate solutions for its partners, their customers, and investors. Its proprietary API and capital solutions integrate into its network of partners to deliver seamless user experiences and greater access to the mainstream economy. Pagaya has offices in New York and Tel Aviv. For more information, visit  pagaya.com . Let's create better outcomes together! We are looking for a dynamic player-coach to lead the Servicing and Collections Oversight function across Pagaya’s portfolio of lender partners. The Vice President will collaborate cross-functionally to manage and develop collections/recovery strategies, mitigate risks, and enhance our portfolio performance. With over 35 partners across asset classes like Personal Loans (PL), Auto, and Point of Sale (POS), this role is heavily partner-facing and critical for maintaining investor confidence. You will take ownership of servicing, collections, loss mitigation/hardship programs, recoveries, and debt sales  while building the strategic roadmap to improve credit performance through economic cycles. Responsibilities Lead, manage, and scale the Servicing and Collections function to optimize our products and achieve optimal loss outcomes. Lead quarterly operational business reviews with partner servicers to review the collections credit (including entry rates, no-pay defaults, early defaults, loan reviews) and operational KPIs (including collections staffing, right-party contacts, promises kept, repo inventory, recovery rates, etc).  Drive best-practices across servicing partners.   Influence credit performance improvement through feed-back loop of collections metrics into front-end underwriting Collaborate with servicing partners to be prepared for economic downturn strategies Be accountable for optimizing servicing, collections, and debt sale across all core asset classes. Navigate the inner workings of negotiating with debt sale agencies, including managing pricing, vendor nuances, and contracts. Advance close and trusting relationships with partners’ servicing and collections teams to understand pain points and drive better business outcomes. Design, manage, and measure collection and recovery tests/strategies that improve roll and charge-off rates, handle Debt Settlement Companies as needed, and maximize lifetime recoveries. Build performance analytics for servicing and debt buyers to establish fact patterns and draw valid solutions. Bolster and influence the servicing/collection departments of young fintech partners to mitigate risk Advise senior leadership and collaborate with key stakeholders across Risk, Credit Operations, Capital Markets, and Finance. Participate in investor & other stakeholder meetings to present Pagaya’s operational risk excellence in servicing and collections oversight Requirements 15+ years of institutional knowledge in consumer finance, with a specific focus on collections, servicing, and recovery. 10+ years of experience and expertise in the US Consumer Collections and Recovery space, particularly with Auto Loans.  Additional experience with unsecured loans collections preferred Intimate knowledge of the consumer credit and collections space, including best practices and applicable laws such as FDCPA, UDAAP, TCPA, and Reg F. Deep knowledge of recovery channels, including debt sales, repossession, litigation, internal recovery, and third-party vendor management. Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders toward an ideal outcome, working across cross-functional organizations and with C-Level decision-makers. Track record in building, productizing, and scaling payment and hardship program strategies. Technically savvy with an understanding of related technology, analytics, and BI tools (including Agentic AI) Our Team Pagaya was founded in 2016 by seasoned research, finance, and technology entrepreneurs with our head quarters located in NYC and Tel Aviv.  We move fast and smart, identifying new opportunities and building end-to-end solutions from AI models and unique data sources. Every Pagaya team member is solving new and exciting challenges every day in a culture based on partnership, collaboration, and community. Join a team of builders who are working every day to enable better outcomes for our partners and their customers. Our Values Continuously Learn - We challenge ourselves for the sake of getting better as individuals, as teams, and as an organization to deliver for our partners. Debat

We have employees nationwide and for the past three consecutive years were named one of the fastest growing Veteran-owned companies in the nation. Please take a moment to browse through our website and learn more about what it means to serve with MKS2. title: Head of Americas Internal Audit
description: Head of Americas Internal Audit Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Stripe Internal Audit provides the Board and management with independent, risk-based assurance, advice, insight, and foresight designed to strengthen Stripe’s ability to create, protect, and sustain value What you’ll do The Head of Americas Internal Audit will lead the strategy, organization, and execution of Stripe’s operational audit portfolio across the Americas. Reporting to the Global Head of Internal Audit and serving as a member of the Internal Audit leadership team, this leader will provide an independent perspective on the risks arising from Stripe’s evolving payments, money movement, financial services, platform, and technology-enabled business models. The role is accountable for developing a high-performing regional audit organization; translating Stripe’s strategy, enterprise risks, and legal entity obligations into a multi-year audit strategy; and delivering clear, timely insight to senior management, the Stripe, Inc. Audit Committee, and relevant regulated entity boards. The leader will partner closely with Technology Audit, Data Analytics, Professional Practices, and Global Licensing Enablement to deliver an integrated global audit program. At Stripe’s request, the individual may also serve as Head of Audit for one or more Americas legal entities. Responsibilities Set the strategy, vision, and operating model for operational audit across the Americas, translating Stripe’s company strategy, enterprise risk assessment, regulatory obligations, and legal entity risk profiles into a multi-year strategy and annual risk-based audit portfolio; anticipate emerging risks and regulatory developments across the US, Canada, Latin America, and the broader financial services ecosystem, adapting coverage as Stripe’s products and legal entity footprint evolve Lead and scale a multifaceted regional organization, including organizational design, hiring, succession planning, leadership development, performance management, and deployment of talent across the highest-priority risks Own the quality and results of the Americas audit portfolio, including risk assessment, planning, issue severity and escalation, reporting, remediation oversight, and timely delivery against approved plans; promote strong governance and accountability, including clear ownership and timely remediation of significant issues, while maintaining alignment with applicable professional standards and Stripe Internal Audit methodology Provide an independent risk perspective to senior management, the Stripe, Inc. title: Principal/Staff Product Manager, Risk Advisory
description: About Us Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of advisory, audit, and tax practitioners at the world's largest CPA firms. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses. We're based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Goldman Sachs, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, and Y Combinator. We value diversity, in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide's team is inclusive, driven, humble, and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building, seeking teammates who are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. As a growth stage startup employee, you'll have the opportunity to build the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners' lives easier by eliminating up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide. About the Role Fieldguide is the market leader in AI-native software for risk advisory and assurance practitioners, working with the majority of the top 100 accounting firms. Our agents already support work across risk advisory frameworks, including SOC, PCI and HITRUST. Now we’re taking the next step: agents that carry the whole advisory engagement, from scoping through sign-off, with practitioners stepping in only for exceptions and judgment calls. As Principal/Staff Product Manager for Advisory, you will help shape the product strategy and roadmap that extends our agents from individual workflows to the full engagement lifecycle. You'll be building from a position of strength, with customers who already trust us and who are skeptical, expert and deeply invested in the quality of their work. What You'll Do Shape the strategy for the end-to-end agentic advisory engagement, and own the roadmap and execution that connect planning, testing and review into a single experience managed by agents Define how practitioners supervise agents: what stays human, how exceptions surface, and how corrections make the agents better over time Work with engineering, design and our AI quality teams to extend our agents across frameworks and engagement phases, with measurable evals and ground truth you help define Work directly with partners, methodology owners and practitioners at top firms, including onsite, and bring what you learn back into the roadmap Partner with customer success, sales and marketing to communicate the strategy and drive adoption of agentic workflows across our largest accounts Who You Are 10+ years of product management experience, including leading a major product line at the staff level or equivalent Experience shipping AI agents in production for a B2B product, with evals and a clear approach to quality, not just AI features Strong familiarity with advisory and assurance work (SOC 2, PCI, HITRUST, ISO or NIST), either as a practitioner or as a PM who built software for it. Strong technical fluency: comfortable talking with engineers about LLM and agent architecture, evals, and trade-offs without needing to write code Able to hold a strategic position under sustained pressure from commercial stakeholders and our largest customers, and to change it when the argument is genuinely good Comfortable working with detail-oriented, skeptical audiences and translating their workflow into product requirements. More About Fieldguide Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are: Fearless: Inspire and break down seemingly impossible walls. Fast: Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection. Lovable: Deliver happiness and 11 star experiences. Owners: Execute and run the business with ownership. Win-win: Create mutual value and earn trust for life. Inclusive: Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams. Benefits Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership Flexible PTO 401k Wellness benefits, including a bundle of free therapy sessions Technology and Work from Home reimbursement

title: Head of Customer Experience & Trust
description: This role can be based in our Rotterdam HQ or in our Cergy office. We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing. With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors. We're looking for a Head of Customer Experience & Trust to be the guardian of the tenant experience on our unified platform. As we consolidate the HousingAnywhere and Studapart operations teams, you will lead a multi-site support and trust organisation across Rotterdam and Cergy and own not just how we respond to our users, but the content, policies, and safeguards that shape their experience before they ever contact us. Your role and impact Lead the shift to AI-first support: Make our AI agent the first point of resolution for tenants and landlords, across all channels. Report on automated resolution, quality and CSAT as seriously as on human SLAs, and prioritise support needs in the Ops automation roadmap. Set the direction for our AI agent: Decide what the AI agent should resolve, what it must never do, and when it hands over to a human. Set its resolution and quality targets, and approve how our policies are explained. Work with the Ops Project Manager, who owns the knowledge base and runs the AI agent day to day. Redesign the team around AI: Lead the CS Team Managers in Cergy and Rotterdam and, through them, a team of experts with local market knowledge. Evolve roles so agents spend their time on complex, sensitive and high-value cases, and on training and supervising the AI. Build one standard way of working across both sites. Own the rules: Own T&Cs and service policies with Legal, and approve how they are explained to users. The Ops Project Manager turns them into help content for users, our AI agent and our teams.  Get ready for high season: Build data-based capacity plans that factor in automation rates, and prepare each peak well ahead: staffing, AI agent coverage, and processes. Select, onboard and manage BPO partners to absorb peak volumes, with clear quality standards, SLAs and costs. Work with the Quality & Training Manager to train BPO agents and monitor their quality, and with the Ops Project Manager to give them the knowledge base and tools they need. Raise the quality bar: Use the Voice of Customer insights and AI-assisted quality reviews led by the Quality & Training Manager to drive change in your teams and raise quality of service and all departments. Own Trust & Safety, AI-assisted: Steer the content integrity and T&S vertical through the dedicated Team Lead in Rotterdam, who manages both sites. This covers listing moderation, fraud prevention and dispute handling. Use AI-based detection and moderation so we always display real content from real users, with human judgement on the final call. Own the cancellation flows: All cancellation assessment and resolution flows sit with you, including post-cancellation retention and relocation. Automate what’s simple and keep a human touch where tenants need it most. Protect our reputation: Protects the platform’s reputation on Trustpilot and Google, and acts on Voice of Customer insights from the Quality & Training Manager. Your profile Professional experience: 5+ years in customer operations, with 2+ years leading multi-team or multi-site support organisations, ideally in a marketplace, travel or high-volume consumer platform. Hands-on AI deployment: You have deployed an AI support agent in production, not just piloted one. You can show how you improved its resolution rate and quality over time. Knowledge and content ownership: You have shaped T&Cs, help content or service policies with Legal and Product. You write rules that both people and AI can follow. Trust & safety literacy : You have owned or worked hands-on with moderation, fraud prevention and dispute resolution, and can balance protection with conversion. Data-driven: You run on SLAs, CSAT, automation and cancellation metrics. You know how to hold quality through seasonal peaks. Peak and partner management: You have prepared support teams for seasonal peaks, and have selected and managed BPO partners, holding them to the same quality standard as your own team. Change leadership: You lead through team leads and have taken a team through a change in roles driven by automation, keeping people engaged along the way. Responsible AI: You know where AI should stop and a human should take over. You are familiar with GDPR and EU AI Act transparency requirements for customer-facing AI. Languages: Fluent English required; French a strong plus. What's in it for you Position based in our Cergy office (hybrid working policy), with visits to HQ in Rotterdam. Executive status with 218 workdays/year (with RTT days off). 50% transport costs covered. 70% health insurance coverage. Meal vouchers. Contribution to fitness membership costs.
